LanguageData.DescBV: The lord of darkness has come for your souls... prepare for the darkness and the dreadful cold!\n\nStay near the light. Only it will save you.
LanguageData.DarknessComesA: Darkness will swallow the world of RimWorld in 60.
LanguageData.DarknessComesB: Darkness will swallow the world of RimWorld in 30.
LanguageData.DarknessComesC: Darkness will swallow the world of RimWorld in 15.
LanguageData.DarknessComesD: Darkness will swallow the world of RimWorld in 5.
LanguageData.DarknessComesE: Darkness will swallow the world of RimWorld in 4.
LanguageData.DarknessComesF: Darkness will swallow the world of RimWorld in 3.
LanguageData.DarknessComesG: Darkness will swallow the world of RimWorld in 2.
LanguageData.DarknessComesH: Darkness will swallow the world of RimWorld in 1.
LanguageData.DarknessComes: The darkness has come for you!
LanguageData.OmniousDarkDesc: The darkness is retreating, but do not feel safe...\n\nThe darkness will come back for you later...
LanguageData.TakenDC: The shadow took {PAWN_nameDef} into the darkness.
LanguageData.DarkestNightSK.event1Only: Passive darkness event: this event only
LanguageData.DarkestNightSK.event1Desc: The passive darkness event is a quieter one. The darkness does not hunt you on purpose, only if you come close. They are also slower.
LanguageData.DescBVPassive: A strange but calm darkness can be seen in the distance, slowly approaching your settlement.
LanguageData.DarkestNightSK.event2Only: Approaching darkness event: this event only
LanguageData.DarkestNightSK.event2Desc: The approaching darkness event is a normal event, except that you see the darkness on the horizon coming sooner, which gives you more time to prepare.
LanguageData.DescBVLooming: A strange darkness can be seen on the horizon, approaching the settlement quite quickly. You had better prepare.
LanguageData.DarkestNightSK.event3Only: Ordinary darkness event: this event only
LanguageData.DarkestNightSK.event3Desc: An ordinary darkness event is a normal event. You have only 60 seconds to prepare. The darkness will hunt down your colonists and break your doors.
LanguageData.DarkestNightSK.voidCountMaxDesc: How many shadows can exist at once. Lower this if the event causes lag.
LanguageData.DarkestNightSK.voidSpawnIntervalDesc: Maximum ticks between spawn attempts. The actual wait is random from 1 to this value. Higher is easier and cheaper.
